lighthouse.name: #cape_name# Light
lighthouse.start_label: The Drowned Lighthouse - a keeper's relief arriving at a dark light

path.name: Cliff Path
path.description: A narrow path climbs the cliff toward a white tower. Far below, waves boom against the rocks.

base.name: Lighthouse Base
base.description: A round room with whitewashed walls. Oilskins hang on pegs, and a spiral stair climbs into the dark.

description.text: The great lamp blazes, and its beam sweeps out across the black water.
Glass on every side, and the sea beyond it. The great lamp in the middle is cold and dark.

rooms.name: #shore_adj.title# Shore
rooms.description: Shingle crunches underfoot and gulls wheel overhead. The sea smells of salt and weed.

rooms.name: Dune Path
rooms.description: A sandy path winds between dunes held together by marram grass.

lighthouse_keeper.name: Keeper #given#
lighthouse_keeper.appearance: {self.Name} sits by the stove, rubbing a swollen knee.

do: "Mind the stair," says {self.name}. "Ninety-nine steps, and every one of them hates me."

profile.motive_text: keep the light burning, the way my father did
goals: find someone young enough to climb that stair
profile.backstory: "Forty years I've kept this light. Never missed a night, till now."
profile.epilogue: {speaker.The} teaches you to trim a wick, and makes you promise to come back when their knees finally give out.

oil_cask.name: oil cask
oil_cask.appearance: A cask of lamp oil stands by the door.
oil_cask.contents_text: On top of the cask sits {contents}.

oil_can.name: can of lamp oil
oil_can.description: A dented tin can, full and sloshing.

great_lamp.name: great lamp
great_lamp.description: A brass lamp the size of a cart wheel, inside a great glass lens.

title: The Dark Lamp
Wreckers' Night
The Light at #cape_name#
dark_lamp.hook: The lamp at {lighthouse} has gone dark, and ships are breaking on the rocks. Its keeper is too old to climb the stair with fuel any more.
dark_lamp.goal: Bring {fuel} to {lamp} at {lighthouse} and light it.

resolutions.title: Light the lamp
resolutions.text: You fill the reservoir from {means}, trim the wick and strike a light. The great lamp roars into life, and its beam swings out over the sea. Far off, a ship's bell answers.

lore.title: The wrecks
lore.text: Three ships have broken on the rocks below {lighthouse} since the lamp went dark. The wreckers on the shore are doing very well out of it.

dark_lamp.ending: The light at {lighthouse} burns every night after that, and no more ships are lost on the rocks.

lighthouse_built.title: The lighthouse
lighthouse_built.text: The lighthouse was built after the great wreck, when two hundred souls drowned within sight of the shore.
